instruction: A crisp studio photograph with a full-shot, eye-level view captures an indoor ballet studio with wooden floors and grey walls. On the left, the young girl with dark hair in a bun (R1) in a white tutu stands with a serious expression, holding the grey ballet barre with her left hand. On the right, the young girl with light brown hair in a bun (R2) in a matching white tutu stands holding the same barre, her right leg bent at the knee. They stand side-by-side practicing their positions under soft indoor lighting that highlights the neutral grey and warm wood tones of the studio.
